newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Texwinca buys HK$150 mln Megawell stake.
newsitem.headline: Texwinca buys HK$150 mln Megawell stake.

text.p: Dyeing firm Texwinca Holdings Ltd said it had agreed to buy a 50 percent stake in knitwear manufacturer Megawell Industrial Ltd for HK$150 million.
The company said it would buy the stake from Perfection Inc, the trustee for a discretionary trust the beneficiaries of which include Texwinca's chairman Poon Bun Chak and his family.
Texwinca said HK$37.5 million of the purchase would be payable in cash and HK$112.5 million would be satisfied by the issue of 19.43 million new shares at HK$5.79 per share.
On completion of the deal, Poon's stake in Texwinca will be increased to 67.9 percent from 66.9 percent.
Megawell is 50 percent owned Perfection and 50 percent equally held by two independent third parties.
